name: DBOMBCENTRAL
description: Master operation and brand. Overarching command structure for all ACAS sub-systems, agents, and projects. CENTCOM Cortex is the cognitive center.

name: ACAS
description: Advanced Cognitive Autonomous System — 4-phase architecture. Phase 1: Foundation (memory, learning, knowledge graph). Phase 2: Agent deployment. Phase 3: Integration. Phase 4: Compliance/deployment.

milestones.phase1: Memory architecture, learning framework, RAG, knowledge graph
milestones.phase2: Task decomposition, specialized agents, coordination protocol
milestones.phase3: System integration, neuro-symbolic hybrid, performance optimization
milestones.phase4: AR 25-50 compliance, audit trails, regulatory framework, live deploy

name: CENTCOM Cortex
description: The central cognitive coordinator of DBOMBCENTRAL. Top-tier agent that holds the plan, delegates to specialists (WON, Forge, Nexus), and maintains operational coherence. Processes intelligence from all departments.

name: WON Agent
description: DBOMB ASCENDENT WON — specialist advisor agent. Handles memory, research, briefs, project tracking, and probability-weighted forward planning. Writes structured intel to Obsidian vault. Free, local, no API required.

name: AI Experience Project
description: Phase 1 experiential AI — memory architecture, bias engine, checker heuristics, generation core. The first working implementation of ACAS Phase 1 components. Modules: biases.py, checkers.py, memory.py, main.py.

name: Anaconda Snake Game
description: Terminal-based snake game (codename: Anaconda). Demonstrates modular engine design — SnakeEngine class handles state machine, input, update loop, and render. Built as a practical Python architecture exercise within the DBOMBCENTRAL ecosystem.

name: CENTCOM Knowledge Base
description: Unified knowledge graph integrating all DBOMBCENTRAL intelligence. Phase 2 target: Neo4j for relational knowledge + FAISS for vector similarity search. Will serve as the RAG backbone for all agents.

name: Agent Orchestration Layer
description: Multi-agent coordination system. 3-tier architecture: CENTCOM Cortex (coordinator) → Specialist agents (WON, Forge, Monitor, Validate, Report) → Shared context layer (memory bus, vector DB). Built on LangGraph + CrewAI.

name: AR 25-50 Compliance Engine
description: Military-standard documentation generator. Auto-formats outputs to AR 25-50 spec. Includes contextual understanding, purpose identification, source verification, and audit trail generation.
